p: Baruch the son of Neriah: Who was Jeremiah's disciple, and wrote his prophecies under him.
words in a book from the: Of which read Jer 36:9,10.
fainted in my sighing: Baruch moved with an inconsiderate zeal for Jeremiah's imprisonment, but chiefly for the destruction of the people and the temple makes this lamentation, as in Ps 6:6.
break down: Meaning that God could destroy this people, because he had planted them.
thou great things for thyself: "Do you think to have honour and credit?" in which he shows his infirmity.
a prize in all places where: Read Jer 21:9.
